sections.body: A BANK keeps money safe. You can put money in (deposit) and take it out (withdraw).
A SAVINGS ACCOUNT may pay you INTEREST: extra money for keeping your money there.
Example: you save 100 at 5% interest a year. After a year you have 105.
When people BORROW money from a bank, they pay interest to the bank. Borrowing costs money!

quiz.q: You save 200 at 10% interest for one year. How much interest do you earn?
When you borrow money, what usually happens?
options: You pay back extra as interest
hints: If you borrow a bike, you return it. If you borrow money from a bank, you return it plus…?
quiz.explain: When borrowing, you usually pay back more than you borrowed (interest).
